def: markedly different from an accepted norm.
ex: When the financial director started screaming... to deal with his aberrant behavior.

def: a deviation from what is normal or expected.
ex: Aberrations in climate have become the norm... making headlines.

def: formally reject or give up (as a belief).
ex: While the church believed that Galileo abjured the heliocentric theory...
the workers abrogated their right to strike for four years.

def: choose not to consume or take part in.
ex: Jessica abstained from anything containing sugar.
Physics textbooks can seem so abstruse to the uninitiated.
